name: Adjustable Hand Grip Strengthener | Finger Exerciser & Hand Therapy Trainer | Grip Strength Trainer for Fitness, Rehabilitation & Arthritis Relief
description:
Build stronger hands, fingers, wrists, and forearms with the Adjustable Hand Grip Strengthener, a versatile finger exerciser designed for strength training, rehabilitation, and daily hand exercises. Featuring 6 adjustable resistance levels, this ergonomic hand trainer is suitable for beginners, athletes, musicians, office workers, and individuals recovering from hand injuries. Whether you're recovering from carpal tunnel syndrome, arthritis, tendon injuries, or simply looking to improve your grip strength, this adjustable hand exerciser helps increase finger flexibility, wrist stability, and overall hand endurance. It is also an excellent training tool for rock climbers, tennis players, golfers, guitarists, pianists, drummers, and fitness enthusiasts who rely on strong hands and finger control. The lightweight and ergonomic design fits comfortably on different hand sizes, while the adjustable resistance system allows you to gradually increase training intensity as your strength improves. Compact and portable, it is perfect for home, office, gym, or travel use.

Key Features
Adjustable resistance with 3 training levels
Strengthens fingers, hands, wrists, and forearms
Improves grip strength and finger flexibility
Ideal for rehabilitation and physical therapy
Helps relieve stiffness caused by arthritis and carpal tunnel
Suitable for stroke recovery and tendon rehabilitation
Ergonomic design for comfortable daily use
Adjustable fit for different hand sizes
Durable and lightweight construction
Ideal for athletes, musicians, gamers, and office workers
Portable design for home, gym, office, and travel
Perfect for rock climbing, tennis, golf, guitar, piano, and drumming

How to Use
Adjust the resistance level according to your strength
Place your fingers securely into the exerciser
Slowly extend and contract your fingers through the full range of motion
Perform multiple repetitions for each hand
Gradually increase resistance as grip strength improves
Use regularly for the best rehabilitation and strengthening results

Material / Composition
High-Quality ABS Plastic
Durable Silicone Resistance Bands
Reinforced Adjustment Hooks
Elastic Finger Loops

Safety Information
Start with the lowest resistance if you are a beginner
Stop immediately if you experience severe pain
Consult a healthcare professional before rehabilitation exercises after surgery or injury
Keep away from excessive heat and sharp objects
Store in a cool and dry place after use
